import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { mix, uv, vec3, smoothstep } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color } = ctx.THREE;

  const group = new Group();
  const timelines = [];
  const disposables = [];

  // 1. DESIGN TOKENS & SYSTEM PALETTE
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  const inkColor = new Color(colors.ink);
  const paperColor = new Color(colors.paper);
  const accentColor = new Color(colors.accent);
  const surfaceColor = new Color(colors.surface);

  // 2. STAGE BACKDROP (Satisfies W-PCP §9 "STAGE, never void")
  // Large backdrop to eliminate void environments and establish atmosphere
  const backdropGeom = new PlaneGeometry(14, 12);
  disposables.push(backdropGeom);

  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    depthWrite: false
  });
  disposables.push(backdropMat);

  const bgUv = uv();
  // Elegant vertical gradient defining the dark-first luxury stage
  backdropMat.colorNode = mix(
    vec3(surfaceColor.r, surfaceColor.g, surfaceColor.b),
    vec3(inkColor.r, inkColor.g, inkColor.b),
    bgUv.y
  );

  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeom, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // 3. MAIN CARD CONTAINER
  const cardGeom = new PlaneGeometry(4.0, 2.5);
  disposables.push(cardGeom);

  const cardMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false
  });
  disposables.push(cardMat);

  const baseUv = uv();
  
  // Custom procedural gradient & lighting accentuation
  const gradientFactor = baseUv.y;
  const gradientColor = mix(
    vec3(surfaceColor.r, surfaceColor.g, surfaceColor.b), 
    vec3(inkColor.r, inkColor.g, inkColor.b), 
    gradientFactor
  );
  
  // Subtle structural top-light border
  const highlightLine = smoothstep(0.97, 1.0, baseUv.y);
  const baseWithHighlight = mix(
    gradientColor, 
    vec3(paperColor.r, paperColor.g, paperColor.b), 
    highlightLine.mul(0.15)
  );

  // Bottom signal identity accent line
  const accentEdge = smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, baseUv.y).mul(smoothstep(0.12, 0.05, baseUv.y));
  const finalCardColor = mix(
    baseWithHighlight, 
    vec3(accentColor.r, accentColor.g, accentColor.b), 
    accentEdge.mul(0.35)
  );

  cardMat.colorNode = finalCardColor;

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeom, cardMat);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // High contrast luxury overlay border
  const borderGeom = new PlaneGeometry(4.04, 2.54);
  disposables.push(borderGeom);

  const borderMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    color: paperColor,
    opacity: 0.06,
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false
  });
  disposables.push(borderMat);

  const borderMesh = new Mesh(borderGeom, borderMat);
  borderMesh.position.z = -0.01;
  group.add(borderMesh);

  // 4. DECORATIVE IMAGE DECORATION
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((texture) => {
      if (!group || !texture) return;
      
      const imageGeom = new PlaneGeometry(3.8, 2.3);
      disposables.push(imageGeom);

      const imageMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
        map: texture,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.8,
        depthWrite: false
      });
      disposables.push(imageMat);

      const imageMesh = new Mesh(imageGeom, imageMat);
      imageMesh.position.z = 0.02;
      group.add(imageMesh);
    }).catch(err => {
      console.warn("Error loading primary asset texture:", err);
    });
  }

  // 5. ATELIER BRAND TYPE LAYOUT
  const titleText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('NOVA ATELIER', {
    fontSize: 0.18,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'center'
  });
  titleText.position.set(0, 0.3, 0.05);
  group.add(titleText);

  const subText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('ARCHITECTURAL HOROLOGY', {
    fontSize: 0.08,
    color: colors.accent,
    align: 'center',
    letterSpacingPx: 3
  });
  subText.position.set(0, -0.1, 0.05);
  group.add(subText);

  const descText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('EXPLORE SYSTEM CATALOG', {
    fontSize: 0.09,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'center'
  });
  descText.position.set(0, -0.4, 0.05);
  descText.opacity = 0.6;
  group.add(descText);

  // 6. INTRO TRANSITION WITH WEIGHT
  group.position.y += 0.35;
  group.scale.set(0.96, 0.96, 0.96);
  
  const introTl = gsap.timeline();
  timelines.push(introTl);

  introTl.to(group.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 1.0,
    ease: "power4.out"
  });

  introTl.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 1.0,
    ease: "power4.out"
  }, 0);

  // 7. CLEANUP IMPLEMENTATION
  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup: () => {
      timelines.forEach(t => t.kill());
      
      // Perform strict recursive resource disposal
      group.traverse((child) => {
        if (child.isMesh) {
          if (child.geometry) child.geometry.dispose();
          if (child.material) {
            if (Array.isArray(child.material)) {
              child.material.forEach(m => m.dispose());
            } else {
              child.material.dispose();
            }
          }
        }
      });

      disposables.forEach(resource => {
        if (resource && typeof resource.dispose === 'function') {
          resource.dispose();
        }
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
